caption: Worked example 1 in its three steps: the state (√3/2, 1/2) has norm 3/4 + 1/4 = 1.0, gives probabilities p(0)=0.75 and p(1)=0.25, and X swaps the amplitudes to 0.5 and 0.866. Only the measurement box turns amplitudes into probabilities.

spec.title: Worked example 1: one qubit
spec.aria: A top-to-bottom flow of four boxes: the state with amplitudes √3/2 and 1/2, the norm check 3/4 + 1/4 = 1.0, the Born-rule probabilities 0.75 and 0.25, and the state 0.5|0⟩ + 0.866|1⟩ after X.
